decision.summary: Formal DAVE-FE decision contract defining DOM structure, CSS layout strategy, token bindings, and allowed files touch map
decision.css_strategy: CSS Grid layout with zero CLS, semantic landmarks, and design token bindings exclusively

assumptions: Target viewport is locked at 1440x900 desktop @ 1.0 DPR with Inter font
Zero expected cumulative layout shift (CLS = 0) via explicit grid template reservations
Strict token compliance with zero raw hex values or arbitrary bracketed spacing
alternatives_rejected: Ad-hoc freeform implementation without reference citations
Float or absolute positioning layouts rejected due to layout shift and responsive clipping
Tailwind arbitrary values (e.g. mt-[37px]) rejected to preserve design system consistency
